meta.title: English Simple Past Tense Proficiency Test

questions.question: Siti ___ to the traditional market with her mother yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: The time marker 'yesterday morning' indicates a completed action in the past, requiring the simple past tense form 'went'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: She go to the library to borrow reference books yesterday.
questions.explanation: The simple past tense of 'go' is 'went'. The time marker 'yesterday' indicates a completed past action.

questions.passage: Andi woke up at 4:00 AM yesterday to prepare for his physical fitness test. He drank a glass of warm water, did some light stretching, and ran around his neighborhood for 30 minutes. After that, he took a shower and ate a healthy breakfast before heading to the training center.
questions.question: What did Andi do immediately after running around his neighborhood?
questions.explanation: The passage states, 'After that, he took a shower...' which happened right after he ran around his neighborhood.

questions.question: Budi ___ not watch the football match last night because he had to study for his university entrance exam.
questions.explanation: The negative form of the simple past tense for all subjects uses the auxiliary 'did' + 'not' + base verb.

questions.question: The new police recruits ___ very exhausted after the 10-kilometer run last night.
questions.explanation: The subject 'recruits' is plural, and the time marker 'last night' requires the plural simple past form of 'to be', which is 'were'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Did the candidates played football during their free time yesterday?
questions.explanation: In simple past interrogative sentences, the auxiliary 'did' is followed by the base form of the verb, not the past form.

questions.question: I ___ my old junior high school teacher at the mall last Sunday.
questions.explanation: 'Met' is the correct irregular simple past tense form of the verb 'meet', matching the time marker 'last Sunday'.

questions.passage: Last month, Dewi decided to join a rigorous study group for the SNBT exam. She attended every session, took detailed notes, and asked the tutors many questions. Her hard work paid off when she received a high score on the mock test.
questions.question: Why did Dewi receive a high score on the mock test?

options.A: Because she studied alone at home.
options.B: Because the mock test was very easy.
options.C: Because she skipped the study sessions.
options.D: Because she asked the tutors many questions and took detailed notes.

questions.explanation: The passage explicitly mentions her attending sessions, taking notes, and asking questions as the reasons for her high score.

questions.question: ___ you finish your UTBK preparation modules last night?
questions.explanation: Simple past interrogative sentences for action verbs begin with the auxiliary 'Did', followed by the subject and the base form of the verb.

questions.question: We ___ (not / eat) nasi goreng for dinner yesterday; we ordered sate instead.
questions.explanation: The negative simple past tense is formed with 'did not' (or 'didn't') followed by the base form of the verb ('eat').

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: She didn't knew the answer to the complex math problem on the exam.
tokens: the answer to the complex math problem
questions.explanation: After the auxiliary 'didn't' (did not), the verb must be in its base form ('know'), not the past form ('knew').

questions.question: When ___ the Indonesian Independence Day proclaimed by Soekarno and Hatta?
questions.explanation: The subject 'Indonesian Independence Day' is singular, and the sentence is in the passive voice in the simple past, requiring 'was'.

questions.question: The officer ___ his wallet while he was walking to the police station yesterday morning.
questions.explanation: 'Lost' is the correct irregular simple past tense form of 'lose', indicating a completed action in the past.

questions.passage: During the final evaluation last Friday, the cadets faced a challenging obstacle course. Many of them struggled with the rope climb, but everyone supported each other. Ultimately, the entire platoon completed the course before the sunset deadline.
questions.question: What was the main challenge mentioned for the cadets during the evaluation?
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly states, 'Many of them struggled with the rope climb,' identifying it as the main challenge.

questions.question: The diligent student ___ all the required documents for the state university application last week.
questions.explanation: The time marker 'last week' requires the regular simple past tense form, which is 'submitted'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: Where did you bought that official uniform last month?
questions.explanation: The auxiliary 'did' requires the base form of the verb ('buy'), not the past tense form ('bought').

questions.question: The commander ___ the troops to advance and secure the area at dawn yesterday.
questions.explanation: The time marker 'yesterday' requires the simple past tense form 'ordered' for this regular verb.

questions.question: Not only ___ he pass the academic test, but he also aced the physical examination last week.
questions.explanation: In negative or restrictive inversion in the simple past tense, the auxiliary 'did' is placed before the subject.

questions.passage: Last holiday, my family and I traveled to Yogyakarta by train. We visited Borobudur Temple early in the morning to avoid the crowds. Later, we bought some traditional batik as souvenirs and enjoyed gudeg for lunch.
questions.question: How did the family travel to Yogyakarta?
questions.explanation: The passage explicitly states, 'my family and I traveled to Yogyakarta by train.'

questions.question: The applicants ___ their best efforts during the intense military drill last year.
questions.explanation: 'Gave' is the correct irregular simple past tense form of 'give', matching the time marker 'last year'.

questions.question: Click the incorrect word and correct it
questions.sentence: I am not sure, but I think I see him at the campus library yesterday afternoon.
questions.explanation: The time marker 'yesterday afternoon' requires the simple past tense form of the verb 'see', which is 'saw'.

questions.question: ___ the candidates submit their administrative documents before the deadline last Friday?
questions.explanation: The simple past interrogative form for action verbs uses the auxiliary 'Did' at the beginning of the sentence.

questions.question: My father ___ a new motorcycle for me after I graduated from high school last year.
questions.explanation: 'Bought' is the correct irregular simple past tense form of 'buy', corresponding to the past time marker 'last year'.

questions.question: We ___ at home last weekend because it rained heavily and the streets flooded.
questions.explanation: The time marker 'last weekend' requires the regular simple past tense form 'stayed'.

questions.question: The teacher ___ us to write a 500-word essay about our future career goals yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Told' is the correct irregular simple past tense form of 'tell', matching the completed past action indicated by 'yesterday'.
